title: Paper Moths
label: Simple
description: A paper-screen parlor game where pale moths settle on a warm lantern and you tap them before they lift off, with a soft ink-wash background and a forty-second dusk timer.
prompt: A paper-screen parlor game where pale moths settle on a warm lantern and you tap them before they lift off, with a soft ink-wash background and a forty-second dusk timer.

notes.means: Names the room, so the playfield reads as paper and wood instead of an empty arcade screen.
Sets the targets as light insects, which decides their size, flutter, and how a tap feels.
Puts a glow in the middle of the sheet and pulls the palette toward amber.

notes.phrase: tap them before they lift off
notes.means: Makes the round a timing swat instead of a scene you only watch.
Ends the round on a clock so the score is a short burst.

title: Gate Comet
label: Simple
description: A single comet looping a dark ring, and you tap only while it crosses a glowing gate arc, tightening the window as the orbit speeds up.
prompt: A single comet looping a dark ring, and you tap only while it crosses a glowing gate arc, tightening the window as the orbit speeds up.

notes.means: One moving mark, so the whole game is about when you press, not what you steer.
Draws the track as a thin orbit instead of a maze or a lane.
Rejects early and late presses, which is the entire scoring rule.
Marks the only slice of the circle that counts as a hit.
Makes the same gesture harder as the streak climbs.

title: Lantern Stack
label: Simple
description: Lanterns drop from a swaying line and you click to set each one on the stack below, keeping the overlap or the tower narrows until it tips.
prompt: Lanterns drop from a swaying line and you click to set each one on the stack below, keeping the overlap or the tower narrows until it tips.

notes.means: The pieces are lanterns, which sets the color and the stacked silhouette.
The next piece travels back and forth, so timing is the skill.
One press places the piece. There is no second chance to nudge it.
Only the shared width survives, which is why a miss shrinks the tower.
Says the failure mode out loud: the stack gets thinner, then it tips.

title: Moss Steps
label: Simple
description: A firefly hops a line of mossy stepping stones over dark water, and you tap to jump only when a stone is under the glow.
prompt: A firefly hops a line of mossy stepping stones over dark water, and you tap to jump only when a stone is under the glow, scoring each new stone before the current one slides away.

notes.means: The player is a small light, so the mark stays readable on dark water.
Turns the platforms into a pond path instead of floating bricks.
One press is a hop. There is no steering in the air.

notes.phrase: a stone is under the glow
notes.means: A hop that lands in the gap ends the run, which is the whole rule.

title: Wick Line
label: Simple
description: A candle flame travels a horizontal wick, and you tap while it crosses a gold band.
prompt: A candle flame travels a horizontal wick, and you tap while it crosses a gold band, with the window tightening until three late cuts put the candle out.

notes.means: The moving mark is a flame, which sets the glow and the failure as the candle going out.
The track is one line, so the game is a timing window and nothing else.
The press only counts inside the band. Early and late are misses.
Paints the only slice of the wick that scores.
Three misses end the round, which keeps it short.

title: Roofline Crane
label: Mid
description: A paper crane flaps through a night of tiled eaves, gravity pulling between roof gaps, with parallax clouds, a soft flap burst, and a best score that stays on this browser.
prompt: A paper crane flaps through a night of tiled eaves, gravity pulling between roof gaps, with parallax clouds, a soft flap burst, and a best score that stays on this browser.

notes.means: Replaces a generic bird with a folded crane, which sets wings, color, and the flap burst.
Turns the obstacles into roofs instead of plain pipes.
The crane falls unless you flap, which is the core loop.
The opening between eaves is the only safe line through each obstacle.
Adds a slower sky layer so the night has depth without new art files.
Stores the record in this browser so a later flight has something to beat.

title: Upstream Koi
label: Mid
description: An endless side-on koi run upstream: the fish keeps moving, you leap over river stones and duck hanging nets, snatch gold scales, and the current gets faster.
prompt: An endless side-on koi run upstream: the fish keeps moving, you leap over river stones and duck hanging nets, snatch gold scales, and the current gets faster.

notes.means: Locks the camera to a side view and a fish that never stops swimming.
Low obstacles are jumped, which gives the run a ground lane.
High obstacles need a second move, so one button is not enough.
Adds pickups that score without being the thing that ends the run.
Speed climbs with distance, which is how an endless run gets harder.

title: Kiln Break
label: Mid
description: A kiln breakout: a clay paddle slides under a glowing ball, bricks fire from pale to cracked across two hits, and a wider paddle shard sometimes falls.
prompt: A kiln breakout: a clay paddle slides under a glowing ball, bricks fire from pale to cracked across two hits, and a wider paddle shard sometimes falls.

notes.means: Names the genre and the clay-kiln look in one phrase.
The bat is a clay slab you slide, not a spaceship cannon.
The ball is the only moving threat, and the glow makes it readable on dark bricks.
Most bricks take more than one bounce, so color shows remaining hits.
A rare drop changes paddle width, which is the only power-up.

title: Orchard Serpent
label: Mid
description: A serpent in an orchard grid eats fruit to grow, but every third fruit sprouts a blossom wall from the edge, and a rare moon pear lets the body turn ghost for a few seconds.
prompt: A serpent in an orchard grid eats fruit to grow, but every third fruit sprouts a blossom wall from the edge, and a rare moon pear lets the body turn ghost for a few seconds.

notes.means: A fenced orchard, not an open wrap-around pit.
The classic growth rule, kept so the twist has something to bend.
Walls arrive on a count, so the player can see the next one coming.
New blocks grow inward from the edge and stay as obstacles.
A rare fruit, distinct from the ordinary apple.
For a few seconds the body can be crossed, which is the twist.

title: Belt Drift
label: Mid
description: A small skiff in an asteroid belt: rotate and thrust to slip between rocks, score near misses when a stone passes close, three hull hits and the run ends, and the screen wraps.
prompt: A small skiff in an asteroid belt: rotate and thrust to slip between rocks, score near misses when a stone passes close, three hull hits and the run ends, and the screen wraps.

notes.means: Rocks drift in open space instead of a scrolling lane.
You steer by turning and boosting, not by sliding a paddle.
Passing close to a rock scores, so dodging is the point rather than shooting.
Three contacts end the run. There is no shield meter beyond that.
Leaving one edge brings the skiff back on the opposite edge.

title: Pulse Lanterns
label: Mid
description: A four-lane rhythm tap where lantern beats fall to a line at a steady 120, with D F J K or a tap on the lane, perfect and good windows, and the combo breaks on a miss.
prompt: A four-lane rhythm tap where lantern beats fall to a line at a steady 120, with D F J K or a tap on the lane, perfect and good windows, and the combo breaks on a miss.

notes.means: Four columns of notes, judged on timing, not a free drum pad.
The notes are lanterns, which sets the color of each falling mark.
A fixed tempo so the chart does not speed-warp under the player.
Two hit grades, tighter and wider, instead of a single timing bucket.
A miss resets the streak, which is what makes the score swing.

title: Loom Shuttle
label: Mid
description: A shuttle races three loom lanes, and you shift it up or down to meet the open warp.
prompt: A shuttle races three loom lanes, and you shift it up or down to meet the open warp, scoring each row that clears.

notes.means: The player is a loom shuttle, which decides the shape and the sideways motion.
Three horizontal bands, so the choice is which row to sit in.
One axis of movement. The shuttle does not speed itself up.
Each row has one gap. The other two are snags.
A pass is a point, and the rows arrive faster as the cloth grows.

title: Tide Bell
label: Mid
description: A listener on a night shore turns to face bells that ring in a circle before each tone fades.
prompt: A listener on a night shore turns to face bells that ring in a circle before each tone fades, with three listens.

notes.means: Puts the ring of bells over water instead of in a menu of buttons.
You rotate a pointer. You do not run between the bells.

notes.phrase: bells that ring in a circle
notes.means: Six fixed bells, one of them live, so the read is which direction.
A shrinking arc is the deadline. Miss it and a listen is spent.
Three late facings end the tide.

title: Pier Watch
label: Advanced
description: A pier tower defense: boats follow a fixed water path, you spend coin on lantern towers, slow buoys, and splash bells in marked pads, upgrade once, and hold the dock across eight w
prompt: A pier tower defense: boats follow a fixed water path, you spend coin on lantern towers, slow buoys, and splash bells in marked pads, upgrade once, and hold the dock across eight waves of skiffs and barges.

notes.means: Says the genre and the dock setting together.
Boats follow one painted route. You do not draw the path.

notes.phrase: lantern towers, slow buoys, and splash bells
notes.means: Three tower jobs: single-target, slow, and splash.
Towers only sit on pads, so placement is a choice among slots.
Each tower has a single paid upgrade, not an endless tree.

notes.phrase: eight waves of skiffs and barges
notes.means: Two hulls, eight waves, then the dock is either held or lost.

title: Courier of Glass
label: Advanced
description: A top-down courier across three hand-drawn floors of a glass archive: move and dash, dodge patrolling wardens that chase when you are close, find keys for locked doors, and gather
prompt: A top-down courier across three hand-drawn floors of a glass archive: move and dash, dodge patrolling wardens that chase when you are close, find keys for locked doors, and gather three glass shards before a three-minute dusk timer.

notes.means: Three authored maps, not a single arena or a random crawl.
Walking plus a short burst, with a cooldown so dash is a resource.
Enemies walk a patrol, then chase only when they can see you.
Doors stay shut until a key from the open side is spent.
The win condition is carrying all three shards, one on each floor.
The run ends at three minutes even if you are still inside.

title: Soot Lantern
label: Advanced
description: A lantern bearer crosses a soot-stained room maze before the oil burns out, collecting drops and avoiding closing shutters.
prompt: A lantern bearer crosses a soot-stained room maze before the oil burns out, collecting drops that refill the glass, avoiding closing shutters, and reaching the exit stair.

notes.means: The player carries a light, so the visible room is a pool around them.
Authored corridors, not an open field.
A draining reserve is the clock. Standing still still costs oil.
Pickups buy time, which is why the route bends toward them.
Marked tiles slam shut on a cycle and block or tax the bearer.
The run is won by leaving, not by clearing every room.

title: Night Press
label: Advanced
description: A letterpress shows a short word, and you tap falling type blocks in order before they pass the platen.
prompt: A letterpress shows a short word, and you tap falling type in order before they pass the platen, with longer words each round.

notes.means: Names the machine, so letters are type blocks and the deadline is a platen.
The target is a word you can hold in your head, not a random string.
You strike the next letter out of a shower of sorts.
Only the next character counts. A wrong sort ends the edition.
Letters that cross the line are missed, which drops the press.
INK through PLATEN, so the same gesture gets stricter.
